alt: 男孩答應把借來的藍色畫冊親手歸還，即使下雨，仍按約帶著畫冊來到朋友家。
scene_prompt: 一諾千金 means keeping one's promise reliably. Two softly linked vignettes of the SAME two modern schoolchildren. LEFT, on a sunny afternoon, a girl lends a distinctive BLUE sketchbook to a boy; they make a solemn friendly pinky promise, fingers visibly linked. RIGHT, later in rain, the SAME boy stands under a plain yellow umbrella outside the SAME girl's home and carefully returns the SAME blue sketchbook, protected dry in a transparent bag; the girl smiles gratefully at the doorway. The visual link between promise and fulfillment is central, with consistent faces and objects. No calendars or writing, no money, no heroic danger. Warm modern neighborhood, soft vignette borders, unified landscape composition.
